<action type="say">
I can help with that.

To reschedule your HVAC appointment, I need a bit more info:

1) How should I look up your appointment?  
   - Confirmation code, or  
   - Phone number on the booking, or  
   - Email address, plus approximate date of the current appointment

2) What new day and time window do you want?  
   - New date (YYYY-MM-DD)  
   - Preferred time window (e.g., “morning”, “afternoon”, or “09:00-12:00”)

Once you share those, I’ll pull up your booking and move it to the new time if possible.</action>
